_about: Herman Witsius (1636-1708). The target is The Oeconomy of the Covenants between God and Man, 'a new translation from the original Latin' (3 vols, New York, 1798), Internet Archive OCR, raw; each title page read. The 1798 text never names its translator (checked: no 'Crookshank' in any volume), so no _translators entry; the 1803 edition (alternates) names William Crookshank, and confirming the two are one translation is left for a later pass. Vol. 1's OCR keeps some long-s misreadings ('fuch', 'alfo'). Witsius's other English works are pending.
